title: Wizart.ai
cardSummary: An ecosystem for material visualization and 3D content, helping shoppers see a product in their own space before they buy it.
sub: A product ecosystem for visualizing interior finishing materials — paints, wallpaper, flooring — across mobile, web and enterprise tools.

cover.alt: Wizart.ai material visualization on a phone

sections.heading: Product Ecosystem
paragraphs: The platform includes several interconnected services:
list: Mobile Visualizer for real-time material visualization
Vision API for integration and recognition tasks
Material Cloud for centralized asset management

sections.heading: User Research & CustDev
paragraphs: Ongoing research through surveys and in-store observations in construction retail environments validated hypotheses and shaped new product directions based on real purchasing behavior.

sections.heading: Analytics-Driven Design
paragraphs: Product decisions were guided by data, not opinion. Key metrics included:
list: Usage of custom vs. predefined interiors
Conversion funnel: product selection → cart → checkout
Most frequently used materials and products
Behavioral insights gathered via Microsoft Clarity

sections.heading: Design System
paragraphs: A structured system built on atomic design principles kept the product scalable and consistent — reusable navigation, forms, tables and controls, shared across every product in the ecosystem.

sections.heading: Marketing & Print
paragraphs: Beyond the digital product, I designed brochures, catalogs, flyers, books and exhibition stands — refined through continuous feedback loops with the client.
